title: test(cli): stored-references binds name fixed row ids, and a run with no JSON says why
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4Jsmd91BqTVB7dSii9uJMV)_
Fixes #32976
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改一个测试文件。`os migrate stored-references` 集成测试给种子行写死 id(不再随机生成),并且当命令没有输出 JSON 时,测试失败信息会带上退出码、oclif 抛出的错误原文、耗时、argv 和 stderr 尾部。
- 为什么改:偶发失败已复现并定位。行 id 是 16 位 nanoid,字母表含 `-`;bind 命令声明了短参数 `-y`(`--yes`),oclif 会把以 `-y` 开头的参数值当成 `-y` 参数,在解析阶段就拒绝(`Flag --id expects a value`,退出码 2),命令一个字节都没写,所以 16 ms、stdout 为空。概率约 1/4096 每个 id。
- 风险与回滚:只动测试,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` 的 `SEEDED_IDS` 注释与 `run()` 里的空 stdout 诊断分支。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`,预期 13/13 通过。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 只改测试、不发布任何包,需要挂 `skip-changeset` 标签(dev 未自挂)。产品侧缺陷(以 `-y` 开头的 id 在任何拼写下都无法 bind)已作为发现上报,未在本 PR 修。

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` only:

1. **The rows the seed writes carry fixed ids** (`SEEDED_IDS`), so every `bind --id` the file passes is deterministic. Before, the ids were minted by the SQL driver as `nanoid(16)`, whose alphabet contains `-`.
2. **A run that prints no JSON document fails loudly.** `run()` no longer answers a bare `{ unparsed: '' }`: it adds the exit code, the exit signal's own message (an oclif parse refusal throws before the command writes a byte), the elapsed ms, the argv, and the tail of stderr. The CONTROL bind assertion prints that payload as its message.
3. **`bind()` refuses an id that opens with `-`** before it reaches the argv, naming why, instead of an opaque parse refusal.

### Root cause (reproduced, not inferred)

oclif 5.1.2's parser (`lib/parser/parse.js`, `parseFlag`) refuses a flag value whenever `findFlag(value)` resolves it to one of the command's flags; `findShortFlag` looks only at the value's second character. `os migrate stored-references bind` declares `yes` with `char: 'y'`, so a row id beginning with `-y` is read as `-y` and refused: `Flag --id expects a value`, exit 2, in **both** spellings, `--id X` and `--id=X`. In the test, that `CLIError` carries `oclif.exit`, so `isExitSignal` swallows it as an ordinary exit and stdout is empty: the exact signature of run 43341064666 (CONTROL failed in 16 ms on `{ unparsed: '' }`, every other case green; next group green on the same shard because the next seed minted different ids).

Measured: a sweep of all 4096 two-character prefixes after `-` through the bind's real flag set refuses exactly the 64 that begin `-y` and no other. With three ids bound per run, roughly one run in 1,400 hits it.

### Not fixed here (reported as a finding)

The same refusal is a product defect at the public door: a row whose minted id begins with `-y` cannot be bound by `os migrate stored-references bind` in any spelling (`objectstack: INVOCATION ERROR — Flag --id expects a value`, exit 2, 0 bytes on stdout under `--json`). It is a family (any string flag carrying a minted id on a command that declares a short flag; 27 commands declare `-y`), so it is reported to the seat with evidence rather than patched in this test PR.

The four exit-3 families refused their own prerequisite (the workspace is not fully built locally): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`. NOT MEASURED locally, reason: prerequisite; CI's Lint and Repo Gates runs them.
